```{r set up directories, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
getwd() #find out where working directory is set
setwd("~/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD") #set working directory

baseDir = getwd()
dataDir = file.path(baseDir, 'data_RG_2025_05')
plotsDir = file.path(baseDir, 'plots_RG_2025_05')
resultsDir = file.path(baseDir, 'results_RG_2025_05')
tablesDir = file.path(baseDir, 'tables_RG_2025_05')
fcsDir = file.path(baseDir, "fcs_files_RG_2025_05")

dirs_to_create <- list(dataDir, plotsDir, resultsDir, tablesDir, fcsDir)
lapply(dirs_to_create, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

# Setup colors

```{r load data}

colors = c()

# colors$heatmap = colorRamp2(c(-4, 0, 4), c("#0033a0", "white", "#FE5000")) # colors for the heatmap

col_fun = colorRamp2(c(-3, 0, 3), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")) # colors for the heatmap
colors$heatmap = col_fun

colors$studyGroup = c("#40A184", "#E0795C")
colors$studyGroup = c("black", "#E6847D")
names(colors$studyGroup) = c("Control", "Down Syndrome")

# colors$studyGroupShort = c("#40A184", "#E0795C")
colors$studyGroupShort = c("black", "#E6847D")
names(colors$studyGroupShort) = c("TC", "DS")

# colors$condition = c("#60B1F5", "#F5A01D", "#89F572", "#A0488B")
# names(colors$condition) = unique(design$condition)
# 
# colors$timePoint = c("#CCEDE7", "#8AA19D", "#6D7F7B")
# names(colors$timePoint) = sort(unique(design$timePoint))

colors$sex = c("#F0A8A8", "#60B1F5")
names(colors$sex) = c("female", "male")

colors$compartment = c("#D5EFD3", "#EFD2B9")
names(colors$compartment) = c("global", "antigen_specific")

colors$volcano = c("#2166AC", "#B2182B", "#E7E7E7")
names(colors$volcano) = c("down", "up", "ns")

# make a color map ageAtDraw
# colors$ageAtDraw = colorRamp2(c(min(design$ageAtDraw), max(design$ageAtDraw)), c("#E7E7E7", "#818181")) # colors for the heatmap
colors$ageAtDraw = colorRamp2(c(5, 52), c("#E7E7E7", "#818181")) # colors for the heatmap
```

# Aging
```{r run aging analyses}
source("cytof_functions.R")

# list all R data files in data/counts
files = list.files("data/counts", pattern = ".Rdata", full.names = T)


for (iFile in 1:length(files) ) {
# for (iFile in 30 ) {
  file = files[iFile]
  # extract the name of the file, without the path and extension
  name = gsub("data/counts/", "", file)
  name = gsub(".Rdata", "", name)
  
  run_age_analysis(name)
}

```
